amendments.body: `crates/tank_harness/tests/e2e_geometry_scaling.rs:20,167-177,224-239` re-tightens concentration parity back to 20%, but the current loading change does not actually get the model back inside that bound. `cargo test -p tank_harness --test e2e_geometry_scaling -- --nocapture` now fails in both `geometry_1x_vs_2x_stocked_metrics_stay_within_20_percent` and `nano_vs_standard_vs_large_stocked_runs_scale_within_20_percent`; the reported peak-TAN deltas are about 49.6% and 61.0%, so the submitted workspace is red again.
amendments.rationale: This is a blocking regression: the current diff makes the targeted harness suite fail.

amendments.body: `crates/tank_core/src/systems/substrate.rs:81-124` does not include microfauna in `estimate_substrate_o2_demand_rate()`. The new redox boundary is therefore unaffected by `MicrofaunaState`, even though the bead defines substrate O2 demand as coming from decomposers, roots, and microfauna. In detritivore-heavy tanks this will overestimate `o2_penetration_depth_cm` and understate the suboxic volume that downstream denitrification/root-zone work consumes.
amendments.rationale: The canonical oxic/suboxic boundary is missing one of the required biological demand terms, so the model is systematically biased under microfauna load.

amendments.body: `crates/tank_core/src/systems/substrate.rs:127-139` computes `D_eff` from a depth-weighted average porosity across the entire stacked bed. For heterogeneous substrates, that lets deep high-porosity layers make the surface diffusion path look easier than it is. A thin low-porosity cap over coarse lower media will therefore produce an oxic boundary that is too deep, even though oxygen has to traverse the cap first.
amendments.rationale: This is a scientific-core correctness gap for the multi-layer substrate stacks the shared-boundary API now supports.

payload.summary: Reviewed the current workspace diff and the oxic/suboxic substrate implementation end-to-end across `substrate.rs`, `state.rs`, `habitat.rs`, and save/load paths. `cargo test -p tank_core substrate -- --nocapture` passed, but `cargo test -p tank_harness --test e2e_geometry_scaling -- --nocapture` currently fails, and I found two additional correctness gaps in the substrate penetration model.
